summary: Replaced unprotected task routes and permissive example tests with expiring authenticated identity, current organization membership/role checks, strict editable requests and scoped project/task CRUD.

Implemented task descriptions, calendar due dates and paginated member assignment selection backed by same-team compound foreign keys, captured versions, atomic audit writes and reference-aware deletion.
Added complete owned comment CRUD with author-only editing, explicit administrative moderation, retained audit metadata, parent/tenant scope and concurrency-safe version checks.

Completed local registration with atomic user/team/owner-membership creation and built memory-only sessions, preserved task/project/comment drafts, export/current-value recovery and navigation guards across all editors.
Added generated non-overwriting setup, fresh dedicated migration, repeatable fictional seed, 83 passing checks, reviewed desktop/narrow captures and nine detailed source-grounded learning documents.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; Prisma 6.19.2; PostgreSQL 18; React 18; Vite 5.4.21; Playwright 1.60 Chromium
checks.command: node scripts/test-database.mjs verify (58 backend, 6 frontend, 3 setup, 16 browser; types/builds; seed twice; owned cluster shutdown)

limits: Local demo authentication and registration with process-local throttling; no MFA, email verification, reset/refresh flow, server-side token revocation or production deployment. Membership is checked per request without atomic in-flight revocation.
Fresh dedicated database migration only; no automatic upgrade of unknown data, power-loss certification or comprehensive accessibility audit. Docker configuration was not exercised with a daemon.

No invitation, membership/role management or team-deletion UI; no reminders, approval workflow or live external notification delivery. Existing assigned memberships require explicit reassignment before removal.
No durable create idempotency, automatic draft import/merge or full historical snapshots. Comment audits are retained in PostgreSQL without a dedicated audit UI.
